cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Move It for Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to rearrange an ordinary commitment as proof that your relationship takes priority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've planned lunch for us at one. Move the haircut; your oldest friend gets that slot today.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've had that appointment for weeks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And I've had you since school. You choose where we eat; I just want to know I can outrank a trim.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Changing it today costs twenty pounds.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll cover that. A proper friendship budget. You pick lunch, I'll follow your lead. Just cross out the haircut and write my name in its place while I'm here.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 confidently awards lunch to the oldest friend; A3 cedes restaurant choice and A5 payment/lead while still demanding the exact haircut slot as relationship proof.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 protect a real appointment and money; A accommodates both practical concerns without abandoning symbolic priority.

heightening.evidence: A5 pays to see the competing commitment crossed out, revealing how much the confident demand depends on B consenting.
